The depth wallpaper feature, inspired by iOS's Wallpaper Subject Segmentation, enables overlaying of a subject above the lock screen clock to show a wallpaper depth effect.

To setup Depth Wallpaper Feature:
1. Set a wallpaper with the subject or a background you want the subject to be above of.
2. Select a subject image to track, this image will be overlaid above the lock screen clock.
3. Modify the offsets and opacity according to your needs.

"The status bar action chip provides real-time updates for both media playback and active downloads/uploads.
Media Progress: • Displays playback progress for music and video when media is playing. • Single tap opens playback controls. • Double tap toggles play/pause. • Swipe left skips to the previous track. • Swipe right skips to the next track. • Long press opens the media app.
Download/Upload Progress: • Shows progress for ongoing downloads and uploads. • Automatically hides when no active transfers are detected. • Single tap opens the app responsible for the download.
The progress bar dynamically switches between media and download states, ensuring you always have the most relevant information at a glance."

Download latest Pixel Beta fingerprint from Google
Import PIF config from a file
Remove the currently active config file
This configuration file will be permanently removed.

1. Tap "Fetch Pixel Beta fingerprint" and select a device from the available list.
2. If no devices are found, import a working PIF config from a trusted source. Config files are not provided; you must find one yourself.
3. Recheck your Play Integrity status.

Always delete the active configuration before loading a new one. Loading an expired PIF config will cause strong integrity via TrickyStore to fail, even with a valid keybox.
Failed to extract Flash Tool API key
The keybox file will be permanently removed.

1. Obtain a valid keybox XML from a trusted source. Keyboxes are not provided; you must find one yourself.
2. Tap "Import keybox" and load the file.
3. Open "Manage target apps" and select Google Play Services and Google Play Store.
4. Set target mode to "Leaf" if your device has a working TEE, otherwise leave it as Auto.
5. Recheck your Play Integrity status.

Always delete the existing keybox before importing a new one. If Google revokes a keybox, it may still allow passing up to device integrity even though strong integrity will fail.
